blocks.html: After the recent successful launch of the “100 Days to the Giant Lantern Festival”, which also kicked off the Christmas festivities in the province of Pampanga, Robinsons Starmills promises to make "season two" of the pandemic memorable with its lineup of exciting activities. Aside from being the venue for the annual Giant Lantern Festival, which provides a platform for the talented lantern-makers to showcase their creation and sell their products, Robinsons Starmills continues its desire to up the ante for the best shopping, dining, and recreational experience for all its customers.

“Robinsons Starmills offers so much more for the Kapampangans and the visitors of the North. Mall visitors will definitely get great deals in our outlet stores, welcome new outdoor dining options and experience fun outdoor sports activities in The Yard” said Jodee Arroyo, Regional Operations Manager for Robinsons Starmills.

Known for its wide array of branded outlet shops, Starmills opens the season with a pre-holiday sale till the end of the month which offers jaw-dropping discounts of up to 80 percent on local and international brands. Start hoarding from Guess, Mango, Nike, The Rail (carrying Vans, Florsheim, Naturalizer, Toms, Circa, K-Swiss), Olympic Outlet (carrying Keds, Sperry, New Balance, Puma), Bambu (Ipanema), Folded and Hung and Bench.

Simultaneously happening is Style Corner, a dedicated section of the mall that showcases the latest arrivals from your favorite Outlet brands. Snag good deals and finally complete your holiday look. Featured brands are also among those participating in the Pre-Holiday Sale, so get your shopping bags ready for more discounted items.

From Nov. 26-28, brace yourself for Black Friday. Fashioned after the traditional post-Thanksgiving super sale in the US, expect additional discounts from sale items during Black Friday at Robinsons Starmills. Expect slashed-down prices on clothes, accessories, bags, and shoes.

Shoppers are entitled to one e-raffle ticket for a minimum purchase of P2,000 from any participating outlet store for a chance to win exciting prizes, including more shopping perks at Robinsons Starmills.

To provide its customers more experiential activities in the mall, Starmills opened the Yard, Pampanga’s newest fitness and outdoor recreation facility. The Yard is an impressive five-hectare property in the rear parking area with a dedicated one-hectare bike trail with humps and jumps as high as two meters.

The Yard also features a 500-meter jogging lane and skating areas for both inline and skateboarding. The Pampanga Skateboarding Society brought in safe, usable obstacles to keep things exciting. The blessing and ribbon-cutting happened last Sept. 18, 2021, with a ceremonial bike ride on the picnic grounds. Robinsons Starmills officially opened the bike trail, RC car track, jogging lanes, and skating areas, together with an organized selling exhibit featuring sports partners and food booths

The celebration continued in the evening with Chill Nights at 6 p.m. Kapampangans enjoyed local street foods, such as Apung Susa's fishballs, chicken balls, dynamite, chicken skin, penoy, siomai, tokwa't baboy, and the iconic balut. Drew's shawarma was also be available, along with MG Food Products’ nachos, tacos and coffee, and beers and cocktails from JJ Concept. Local singer-comedienne Ara Muna performed on opening night. You can experience chill nights yourself every Fridays and Saturdays this September and October.

Pet Park and the launch of Happy Pets Club will happen on Oct. 23, 2021, Saturday. Created in partnership with Top Breed, this exclusive playground for pets and fur parents is free to all pet owners. Perks and privileges await those who sign up for the Happy Pets Club. There will be a pet blessing, pet deworming and vaccination, plus games and prizes. Join the online pet photo contest to win invites to the launch.

The excitement never stops here at Robinsons Starmills, your ultimate destination in the North for outlet shopping, great food and outdoor leisure. Don’t forget to bring your family for a drive-in to this year’s Giant Lantern Festival, happening on December 16, 2021.
